wave: TOKYO PRIORITY D RANKED NEXT PREFLIGHT 4
phase: Bounded metadata reranking and current/current-linked first-party evidence preflight only
scopeBoundary: The remaining unresearched Tokyo Priority-D inventory was reranked from repository metadata alone under the established performance-oriented rule, and current/current-linked first-party evidence was checked for the top five ranked candidates in order. Research stopped at the five-candidate ceiling before reaching three ADOPTs. No two-pass transcription, source or range authoring, production integration, generated artifact, fingerprint, or production-total change was made.
policyBasis: ADOPT requires current/current-linked first-party issuer evidence that fixes, without inference, one representative configuration with a complete issuer-numbered seat set, issuer-defined row/block/floor/category ownership, a configuration boundary, and the treatment of accessibility, removable, and alternative configurations, so that an independent two-pass transcription can reproduce it losslessly. DEFER covers a missing or incomplete printed ID set or an unsupported configuration definition. HARD-CASE DEFER is reserved for an otherwise complete numbered chart whose issuer subtotal or accessibility relation alone remains unreconciled. Capacity fitting, invented seat IDs, geometry-derived ownership, configuration mixing, assigning IDs to unnumbered wheelchair spaces, and arbitrary deletion of printed IDs for accessibility reasons are prohibited. Per the current venue-source transport policy, an HTTP-only current official issuer is not by itself a DEFER/HOLD reason; HTTPS is preferred when it works, HTTP-only is recorded under an httpOnlyOfficial waiver only if the candidate otherwise reaches ADOPT, and unofficial HTTP sources remain non-waivable. The transport waiver relaxes no seat-evidence requirement.
performanceOrientedRankingRule: Dedicated theater, concert hall, live-event hall, or auditorium with continuing stage, theatre, live, or concert use and likely assigned-ticket sales.
Civic/public halls with explicit performance use.
Recreation, multipurpose, meeting, and conference spaces.

existingDispositionsExcluded.method: Every inventoryId, its venueSourceId, and its facility-space identity were checked against data/venue-inventory/tokyo.json, data/venue-sources, and every prior formal venue report before ranking; none of the named records, and no other blocked/production record, was reopened or re-audited.

metadataReranking.inputsUsedForRanking: data/venue-inventory/tokyo.json only (priority, researchStatus, venueSourceId, eligibility, officialDisplayName, facilityName, spaceName, category, capacity, officialFacilityUrl, discoveryUrlRaw). No Web research informed the ranking.
metadataReranking.candidatePool: 969 Tokyo Priority-D inventory records reduce to 807 with researchStatus not-started or source-located and venueSourceId null (5 fewer than the prior preflight's 812, reflecting that preflight's own ADOPT/DEFER closures: 0861/0893/0818/0813 blocked and 0635 promoted to production). 274 of those carry an officialFacilityUrl or discoveryUrlRaw.
metadataReranking.tier1Screen: 21 of the 274 carry a dedicated performance identity in the normalized display name (シアター/THEATER/劇場/能楽堂/舞台/ライブ/LIVE/スタジオ/演芸場/座). One of the 21, tokyo-official-0460 シアター H, was excluded before ranking as the identical facility-space as already-produced tokyo-coverage-theater-h (theater-h-standard), leaving 20 genuine tier-1 candidates. The 20 were ordered by the established tie-break: source-located plus likely-eligible plus a direct operator URL plus a recorded capacity outranks not-started plus needs-research plus a null capacity; within each group, larger recorded capacity was used as a secondary tie-break, then inventoryId order for exact capacity ties.

metadataReranking.tier1NotSelected: Ranked below the selected five: tokyo-official-0688 国立能楽堂〔研修能舞台〕 (100, not-started; a distinct training-stage space from produced sibling national-noh-theatre-standard), tokyo-official-1147 くにたち市民芸術小ホール〔スタジオ〕 (70), tokyo-official-0210 シアターウィング (60), tokyo-official-0800 Live Spot Terra 西荻窪 (60), and the remaining null-capacity tier-1 records (0342, 0535, 0589, 0590, 0718, 0742, 0764, 0765, 0769, 0881, 1002). metadataReranking.tiers2and3NotSelected: Civic performance halls and recreation/multipurpose/meeting spaces rank below tier 1 and were not opened by this preflight.

facilitySpaceDuplicateCheck.method: Each selected inventoryId, its venueSourceId, and its facility-space identity (facility name, space name, city, officialFacilityUrl/discoveryUrlRaw) were checked against data/venue-sources, the complete Tokyo inventory, and every prior formal venue report before research.
facilitySpaceDuplicateCheck.result: All five selected records had venueSourceId null and no prior formal disposition, and none shares a facility-space identity with any produced or blocked record. tokyo-official-0691 and tokyo-official-0692 are distinct spaces (スタジオ1 / スタジオ2) within the same LUMINE 0 facility, each judged on its own current evidence; both share the same single facility page because the operator publishes no per-studio seating detail (see researchOrder rank 4 and 5).
facilitySpaceDuplicateCheck.mandatoryExclusionsHonored: All twelve DEFER and three HARD-CASE DEFER records listed in existingDispositionsExcluded, plus the two production duplicates, were excluded from the pool and were neither reopened nor re-audited.
